# Capability Maturity Model

Status: optional for platforms, tooling, reusable infrastructure, or multi-environment capabilities where "implemented" would overclaim readiness.

## Baseline Relationship

Extends/Complements: Current/Future Capabilities and Project Health.

Why separate: `<explain why this project needs maturity stages beyond current/future classification>`

## Levels

1. Structural - source/contracts exist; behavior is not yet proven.
2. Locally Proven - bounded local evidence passes at an Evidence SHA.
3. Operational - the intended project workflow works in its supported environment.
4. Portable - required target environments/backends pass equivalent claim-scoped proof.
5. Externally Accepted - named human/provider/device/network acceptance is recorded.
6. Mature - operational history, recovery, maintenance, and limitations support the claim.
